svg.text: VKS cluster · node pool (autoscale 1–N) · VPC 10.10x.1.0/24 · zone HCM03-1C · CNI Calico / Cilium
observability + ops · SSO via a single oauth2-proxy (L7 ingress does the OIDC the L4 NLB could not)
vs VMs: one pod per service with real requests/limits + HPA; Service DNS +
NetworkPolicy replace hand-maintained cross-box security groups; Ingress +
cert-manager replace Caddy; a single oauth2-proxy replaces one-per-dashboard;
kubectl replaces Portainer + agents. Caveat: HCM03-1C is the only enabled AZ →
no cross-AZ HA; VKS force-upgrades clusters after a K8s version’s end-of-support
Boxes inside the cluster = Kubernetes workloads.
Managed PG / MemStore / S3 stay external.
VNG NLB (L4) — ONE LB, provisioned by the ingress Service type=LoadBalancer
DNS: beta.leocdp.com (uat) / leocdp.com (prod) → LB public IP
NGINX Ingress Controller + cert-manager (Let’s Encrypt TLS) — L7 path routing
/ → frontend /c360api → api /auth → keycloak /ads → ads /data → tracking /jaeger · /netdata · /pgadmin → oauth2 (SSO)
Platform add-ons: NGINX ingress · cert-manager · oauth2-proxy · BlockStorage CSI bs.csi.vngcloud.vn (RWO PVCs) · NetworkPolicy · Secrets (sealed / external-secrets)
CI builds → GHCR (or VNG vCR) · tags sha-<git> / vX.Y.Z
GitOps (Argo CD / Flux) or kubectl / Helm apply
Terraform: vks module + managed PG / Redis / S3
